name: Magnusavis
sum: Large Maastrichtian enantiornithean from the Hell Creek Formation of Montana known from a foot bone.
holotype: CCM V2019.5.1, an incomplete right tarsometatarsus and a toe bone from Carter County, Montana, kept at Ekalaka.
biology: Not given in the sources used beyond its large size.
author: Clark et al. 2024
